decisions.reason: The source specifies the drain connection target for Unit 3's toilet only; it does not change Unit 1's toilet location or drain-alignment constraint.
The Unit 3 toilet connection decision does not alter Unit 2's bathroom placement, toilet constraint, or door position.
Connecting the Unit 3 toilet to the existing WC drain does not necessarily change the kitchen-counter arrangement or bathroom-door clearance strategy.
The toilet drain connection target has no entailed effect on open-plan kitchen configuration, cabinet count, or cabinet dimensions.
The Unit 3 toilet drain connection does not change whether the balcony is retained or incorporated into the adjacent room.
The plumbing connection target does not affect the requirement for one private steel entrance door per dwelling.
The source identifies an existing drain as the connection target but does not require constructing, demolishing, or otherwise changing any wall.
The toilet drain connection target does not alter the furnished drawing format or the furnishings and appliances that must be shown.
The Unit 3 toilet drain connection does not change the separate goal of reducing or productively using the wide corridor area.
The Unit 3 plumbing decision does not alter Unit 1's 2+1 room configuration.
